scope: One exact recipe: ordinary durum-wheat couscous rehydrated with drinking water, plain firm tofu and raw tomato. No draining, pressing, rinsing, frying or unlisted additions.
operation: Sum macros per 100 g of measured edible as-sold inputs. All used food and absorbed water are served. No cooked per-100-g value, yield or retention factor is invented.

sources.supports: Ordinary durum-wheat couscous consists of steam-treated grains and is used in salads. This describes the food class; no brand-specific nutrition, price or organic status is transferred.
Manufacturer example of covered rehydration with boiling water, followed by separating the grains. Its seasoned recipe, water ratio and nutrition are not transferred.
Plain firm tofu can be served cold in salads. No preservation claim or product facts transferred.

Normal food preparation changes macronutrients relatively little; water content changes concentration. This is qualitative support for the explicitly labelled input-sum estimate, not an exact numerical retention or yield.

limitations: User must opt in. Values describe the selected edible input and are estimates of the served meal. Source classes do not certify individual products, allergies or cooked portion weight. Other cooking or discarded food requires a different reviewed basis.
